request_id.description: DECIDE request_id. EXECUTE must be bound to a prior discovery.

scope.description: Concrete scope built by ChatGPT from the capability contract and canonical maps returned by DECIDE.

include_context.description: Request CONTEXT when the capability has a temporal dimension. CONTEXT must preserve all non-temporal scope dimensions.

decision_token.description: Signed authorization returned by DECIDE. EXECUTE verifies request_id and capability against it.
